It names no customer, states no tier as a fact about anyone, and routes no hop (the blind solver reached the factor from the record's `prescribed_lpm` and would have computed 258.915 anyway); the solution stays unique. Recorded as a mislabelled illustration that coincides with a task intermediate, for the coordinator's judgement on whether the edge example should use a value that is not a live world figure.
